# Fresnel glow

Adds light where a surface turns away from the camera, the rim lighting of force fields, energy shields and selected objects. Inverted, it lights the faces toward the camera instead.

<EffectDemo effect="fresnel-glow" />

## Usage

```ts
import { patchMaterial } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { fresnelGlow } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/fresnel-glow';

const effect = fresnelGlow({ preset: 'shield' });
patchMaterial(mesh.material, effect);
const clock = new THREE.Clock();
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => {
  effect.tick(clock.getDelta());
  renderer.render(scene, camera);
});
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.color = '#5ad8ff'`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter   | Type                                                      | Default     | Range    | Description                                                                       |
| ----------- | --------------------------------------------------------- | ----------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `color`     | hex color (theme: [`accent`](/guide/holocss#theme-roles)) | `'#5ad8ff'` |          | Glow color.                                                                       |
| `intensity` | number                                                    | `2`         | 0 – 10   | Brightness at the rim, in linear units (above 1 blooms with HDR effects).         |
| `power`     | number                                                    | `3`         | 0.5 – 10 | Rim width: higher values hug the silhouette.                                      |
| `bias`      | number                                                    | `0`         | 0 – 1    | Glow added everywhere, before the rim.                                            |
| `inverted`  | boolean                                                   | `false`     |          | Light the faces toward the camera instead of the rim.                             |
| `pulse`     | number                                                    | `0`         | 0 – 1    | Slow breathing of the brightness, as a fraction of it (stops when motion is off). |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset     | Settings                                                           |
| ---------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `shield`   | `color: '#4cc9ff'`, `intensity: 3`, `power: 2`                     |
| `selected` | `color: '#ffd166'`, `intensity: 2.5`, `power: 4`, `pulse: 0.3`     |
| `ghost`    | `color: '#c0b3ff'`, `intensity: 1.2`, `power: 1.5`, `bias: 0.15`   |
| `core`     | `color: '#ff7a3d'`, `inverted: true`, `power: 2`, `intensity: 1.5` |

Apply one with `fresnelGlow({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Materials · tracked as story X12.3 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Kind:** material effect. `patchMaterial(material, effect)` splices it into MeshBasic, Lambert, Phong, Standard, Physical, Toon and Matcap materials, so lighting, fog and shadows keep working; `unpatchMaterial` removes it. See [material effects](/guide/materials).
- **Motion:** Settles: when motion is off it switches to still values (`pulse: 0`) without changing your settings.
- **Size:** 5.3 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/fresnel-glow`, including the shared effect runtime.

## Credits

Original implementation (MIT). References: Rim term after Schlick, An Inexpensive BRDF Model for Physically-based Rendering, 1994.
